Step 3. The subharmonic functional \(\Phi_{01270013}\) on the Sobolev space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01270013}\| \leq C_01270013\) by the subharmonic embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via algebraic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01270011 \cdot C_01270012 \cdot C_01270013\).
